newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria cbank audit sent to parliament committee.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria cbank audit sent to parliament committee.

text.p: Parliament's budget and finance committee will consider results from Deloitte & Touche's completed audit of the Bank of Bulgaria (BNB) 1996 balance sheet before passing it on to parliament plenary hall for approval.
After approval, results are expected to be publicly released.
The BNB declined to give details of the audit but said in a statement the international auditing firm Deloitte & Touche completed its audit.
"Deloitte & Touche signed all documents concerning the BNB balance sheet audit after it was completed," the statement said.

An international audit of the BNB was part of the preparations to introduce a currency board system, which was introduced two weeks ago. A currency board system is a fixed exchange rate regime and was launched as part of a reform and lending agreement with the International Monetary Fund.

Deloitte & Touche did BNB's 1995 international audit after winning a tender among four other foreign auditors. The BNB did not hold a tender this year due to lack of time. The auditor was appointed in May.
